about_the_game:
Based on an urban legend...

Kidopolis is a children's amusement park where kids can play pretend working jobs and receive an amount of Kidbux as payment. 

One of the attractions in the park is the Chizzo Tunnel. A short underground tunnel built by Chizzo Corp. to promote their new flavors of cheesy snacks. 

However, many children report Cheddar Chizzo, Chizzo's mascot, appearing in the Chizzo Tunnel in Kidopolis asking children to follow him further into the tunnel. Adults that went as kids also started remembering him.

Now that you find yourself stuck in Kidopolis with the only potential exit being within the tunnel, you must solve puzzles, avoid traps and find your way through the maze-like layout of the Chizzo Tunnel. 

Just keep finding the ladder.

In the first-person perspective you must brave the Chizzo Tunnel. Avoid Cheddar Chizzo and use power ups to make sure you are not caught. Solve puzzles to progress and collect Kidbux, the in-park currency given to children for participating in the park's activities. Use Kidbux to purchase different flavors of Chizzos. Each providing a different perk to aid along the way.

name: Chizzo Tunnel
short_description: You ignored the whispers, but curiosity trapped you in the Chizzo Tunnel. Now, evade the sinister Cheddar Chizzo in this heart-pounding, claustrophobic horror escape!
